The camera might be a bit worse, I've never used a Moto X 2014 before, but IIRC most reviews didn't say good things about the camera.

But the performance and look of the OS will probably blow you away after TouchWiz, just don't forget to upgrade to Lollipop.

Ardbeg Uigeadail

54.2%
$60

Nose: Sweet and salted meat, heather, brine, some pepper spice, pleasant floral notes, warm and sweet smoke, cocoa. The nose reminds me a bit of Port Charlotte 7 which was probably my favorite bottle of peated Scotch so far.

Palate: Creamy mouthfeel, dry and meaty smoke, heavy on the heather, with spice notes rolling on in followed by wood flavors. There's some noticeable sweet sherry influence as well, but it's subdued a bit by the heather.

Finish: Dry. Damp wood, more heather. Mouth tingling spice, caramel and toffee for sweetness, some salted turkey.

Notes: I'll admit the nose got me all amped up for something PC7-like, but the strong heather notes and lack of strong sweet and salty meat notes on the palate disabused me of that pretty immediately. I enjoy this and I'm excited to spend more time with it, but it didn't quite hit all the notes I was hoping for (that's on me, not Ardbeg). I'm excited to explore the rest of their lineup as well.

Score: 88/100
